query: I just spent the last 10 minutes trying to take photos of the street performers outside my hotel here, and their juggling routine was so impressive I must have taken 50 shots, even got a short video of them lighting torches mid-juggle. I was going to send the best ones to my cousin back home, who’s been practicing juggling as a hobby for a couple years now, I know he’d love to see how these guys do their tricks. I also stopped at a little café just now and had the most amazing lavender latte, I’m definitely going to try to replicate the recipe when I get back from this trip. Anyway, I’m having a problem with my phone right now: I can’t get any mobile data to work at all, I already checked and airplane mode is turned on, my regular data mode is off, data saver mode is enabled, I already got a notification that I’ve exceeded my data usage limit for the month, and I’m currently abroad with roaming turned off, can you help me figure out if there’s any way to fix this?
